business.body: The Company provides Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) services in the power sector, having worked on the 1980 MW Super Critical Thermal Power Project at Lalitpur, District Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, where it is currently carrying out EPC services. Alongside this, it renders Business Support Services, which the Board states are being used to meet operational expenses and reduce current losses. It also holds a 49.50% associate stake in Ojas Industries Private Limited.
business.title: What they do

business.body: - Ojas Industries Private Limited — associate: Associate company; the Company holds 9,900 equity shares of Rs. 10 each constituting 49.50% of its total share capital as on March 31, 2026. Significant influence arises from control of more than 20% of total equity share capital (Form AOC-1 Part B). Not liquidated or sold during the year.
business.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)

outlook.body:
- Continue carrying out Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) services in the power sector, building on work done at the 1980 MW Super Critical Thermal Power Project at Lalitpur, District Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh.
- Render Business Support Services to meet operational expenses, reduce current losses and enhance the value of the Company.
- Compete on quality, timely delivery and meeting customer expectations in order to win further contracts and orders.
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: The Company discloses no capex or capacity-expansion programme. Its only project-related disclosure is that it has worked on the 1980 MW Super Critical Thermal Power Project at Lalitpur, District Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, and is currently carrying out Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) services in the power sector there; this is customer project work, not the Company's own capacity. Management says it expects to win more contracts and orders in the years ahead, and is meanwhile rendering Business Support Services to meet operational expenses.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Management states it has received a very positive response to its EPC work in the power sector, which it believes positions the Company to seize new opportunities.
- Total income rose to Rs 570.43 lakh in the year under review from Rs 319.42 lakh in the previous year, while the net loss narrowed to Rs 58.15 lakh from Rs 946.91 lakh.
- Management says it is confident of growing the order book significantly by winning more contracts and orders in the years ahead; no order-book quantum is disclosed.
